_about: Statuses NO published source carries. Author-supplied, from playing Ruthless.
_why: GGG's Item Filter Information feed has exactly three verbs: new, removed, returning.
The game has at least two more, and both look like LIVE to the feed:
drop_disabled  — the base still exists and is not in any Removed Items list, but nothing
drops it right now. GGG does this to last league's content routinely and
does not always announce it in a section a filter author can parse.
event_only     — obtainable only inside a special event league, absent from the base game.
This is a sharper limit than the 3.16 publication cliff. The cliff makes the feed INCOMPLETE
about old removals; this makes it WRONG about a current one. Wildwood's charms are the proof:
the feed still reads them LIVE since 3.23 because 3.24, 3.25 and 3.26 never name them, the
3.24 patch notes do not mention Wildwood at all, and FilterBlade's Ruthless filter has zero
mentions of them. Only the author knew, from playing.
★ audit_legacy.py reads this FIRST, ahead of the feed and ahead of the Ruthless wiki. An entry
here is a report from someone standing in the game, which outranks a forum post about it.
_maintenance: Add an entry when the author reports a status the feed cannot express. Always record WHO said it and WHEN, so a later league can retire the override instead of it becoming folklore.

drop_disabled._note: 3.28 Mirage introductions, switched off for 3.29. Not in any Removed Items list — the feed reports all six as LIVE since 3.28.

drop_disabled_wildwood._source: author, 2026-08-19; corroborated by FilterBlade (0 mentions) and by the 3.24 patch notes not naming Wildwood at all
drop_disabled_wildwood._note: Affliction league content removed from the drop table when the league ended. The feed never retires them, so without this entry the audit reports them LIVE since 3.23 forever.

event_only._note: Sentinel (3.18) content. Drop disabled in the base game, but re-enabled inside special event leagues — which has happened exactly once since Sentinel. So neither LIVE nor RETIRED: it can come back without a league launch, which is why it is its own status rather than a removal.
